(447)༄༅/ /sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob phrin las kyi khrid 'khor ba'i 'phrang sgrol bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (447)༄༅// sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob phrin las kyi khrid 'khor ba'i 'phrang sgrol bzhugs so//

(448)༄༅// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rab tu rgyas pa la// rang byung ye shes utpal rnam rol pa// dmigs med snying rje'i dri bsung 'phro ba can// bcom ldan sgrol mas 'gro kun bskyangs bar gsol// gang gi zhabs zung padmo'i cod pan la// tshangs dbang drag po 'jig rten skyong bzhi dang*/ 'jig rten dregs ldan gtsug gis gus bsten pa'i// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// bcom ldan sgrol mas mi tra dzwa ki la// man ngag bsgom pa'i rim pa gsungs pa rnams// snyan nas snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i gter chen 'di// 'gro ba gdung ba sel phyir yi ger bkod// 'dir bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob phrin las kyi khrid 'khor ba'i 'phrang sgrol zhes bya ba 'di ston pa byed pa la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong dang khyad par ro// dang po la bzhi ste/ dal 'byor rnyed par (449)dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa rnams spyi dang mthun no// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ ci byas thams cad byang chub kyi lam du 'gro bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi khrid/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed par lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi ni spyi dang mthun no// de dag ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni don gnyis te/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo// dang po la gsum ste/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa sku'i khrid ni/ tshad med pa bzhi sngon du 'gro bas// swabhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sa gzhi thams cad ri bo ta la'am/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su gyur pa las/ de'i dbus su mtsho sngo zhing dwangs pa'i dkyil du ne'u gseng me tog gis mdzes (450)pa dang*/

de'i dbus su paṃ las utpal rgyas pa/ yu ba gser las grub pa ze'u 'bru dang lo 'dab rlung gis bskyod pa las dam pa chos kyi sgra 'byung ba de'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ tāṃ las utpal ljang khu tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ dar gyi sham thabs can/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas utpal 'dzin pa/ g.yon utpal snyan gyi thad kar rgyas pa'i yu ba thugs kar mtheb srin gyis 'dzin pa/ nu ma 'bur ba/ spyan dkyus dang smin dkyus ring ba/ ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings nas zar bu rked sor g.yo zhing 'gying bag dang bcas pa/ zhi ba/ sgeg pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ rin po che sna lngas rtse phran dang snyan cha/ mgul rgyan dang dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub/ sku rags dang do shal/ dar gyi cod pan dang mu tig chun pos brgyan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can snang la rang bzhin med pa/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgom pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ mthing kha/ hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ po ta la'am/ g.yu lo bkod pa nas/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ rang dang dbyer med du gyur/ slar 'od zer 'phros/ (451)rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ dri ma dag /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ snying khar utpa la'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su tāṃ yig ljang khu las sngags kyi phreng ba mar gad kyi mdog lta bu las 'od 'phros/

lus kyi nang gang dug lnga sbyangs phyir 'phros/ snang ba 'od kyi gzhal yas khang du byas/ sems can la phog /sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus g.yas su 'khor ba la dmigs nas/ thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags sgra sgrogs par bsam la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes sngags 'dren no// mthar snang ba 'od du zhu nas nang bcud la thim/ nang bcud 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang lus 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i tāṃ yig la thim/ tāṃ yig nā da la thim/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs med ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag go /de ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa de nyid gsal 'debs pa 'od zer spro ba sna'i 'khrid ni/ rang nyid sngar ltar sgrom mar bskyed pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad sku'i sgrol ma sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgyas utpal 'dzin pa/ g.yon utpal snyan gyi thad kar rgyas pa'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa spyan dkyus dang smin dkyus ring pa sogs sngar ltar bskyed pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig dkar po las sngags phreng dkar po mu tig lta bu 'khor ba/ de las 'od zer dkar po (452)dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi klad pa'i nang gang*/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /gti mug byang*/ 'od zer phyi rol tu phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku la phog /sku gzi mdangs dang ldan par byas/ sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas spyi bo'i sgo lam la thim pas sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas par bsgom la sngags 'dren no// mgrin par pad zla'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i snying khar/ pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig dmar po la sngags kyi phreng ba padma rā ga'i mdog lta bu las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/

mgrin pa'i nang gang*/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /'dod chags dag /'od zer phyogs bcur phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsung la phog /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan par byas/ de dag gis gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus nas mgrin par thim/ gsungs dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i byin rlabs zhugs/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsgom la sngags 'dren no// snying khar pad zla'i steng du/ mi bskyod pa thugs kyi sgrol ma mthing kha'i thugs khar/ pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig mthing kha la sngags kyi phreng ba baiḍūrya lta bu las 'od 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang gang*/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /zhe sdang dag /'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag thams cad kyi thugs rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i chos nyid ji lta ba rtogs pa dang*/ chos can ji (453)snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par bsdus nas/ rang gi snying kha'i sgrol ma la thim pas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs/ me long ye shes mngon du byas par bsgoms la sngags 'dren no// lte bar pad zla'i steng du rin 'byung yon tan gyi sgrol ma sku mdog ser mo lta bur bskyed pa'i snying khar pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig ser po las sngags phreng gser mdog lta bu 'khor ba las 'od 'phros/ rang gi lus nang gang*/ 'dod pa dang nga rgyal las gyur pa'i sgrib pa dag /'od zer phyir 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la phog /yon tan mtha' dag rgyas par byas/ de dag gi yon tan thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang gi lte ba'i sgrol ma la thim/ yon tan gyi byin rlabs mtha' dag zhugs/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas par sgom la sngags 'dren no// gsang gnas su pad zla'i steng du don grub phrin las kyi sgrol ma ljang khu/

rang lta bu'i thugs khar pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig ljang khu las sngags phreng margad lta bu 'khor ba las 'od zer ljang khu 'phros/ gsang gnas yan chad gang*/ chags pa dang phrag dog dag /'od zer phyogs bcur phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la phog /phrin las lhun grub tu byas/ de dag gi phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer ljang khu'i rnam par bsdus nas rang gi gsang gnas su thim pas phrin las kyi dngos grub thob/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes mngon du byas par bsgom la sngags 'dren no// yang rim pa ltar/ (454)spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas kyi gnas lngar/ sgrol ma dkar/ dmar/ mthing*/ ser/ ljang khu lnga las/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu rang gi lus kyi gnas lngar phog /gti mug /'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog lnga sbyangs/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rigs drug la phog /de dag gis gti mug /'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog lnga sbyangs/ chos dbyings/ sor rtogs/ me long*/ mnyam nyid/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'am/ rnam snang*/ 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod pa/ rin byung*/ don grub/ las kyi sgrol ma'i go 'phang lnga la bkod/ tshur 'dus so sor thim/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs rnams zhugs/ dug lnga dag /ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ sku lnga thob par bsam la sngags 'dren no// de dag ni 'od zer spro bsdu'i khrid kyi dmigs pa'o// 'di ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'i khrid/ bum dbang gi don yin la/ sprul sku mngon du byas bya yin no// gsum pa bzlas pa sngags kyi spro bsdu'i khrid ni/ rang sgrol ma gong ltar gsal gdab pa'i gnas lngar/ sgrol ma rigs lnga bskyed do// spyi bor dkar mo/ mgrin par dmar mo/ snying khar mthing kha/ lte bar ser mo/ gsang gnas su ljang khu rnams kyi snying khar pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lnga las sngags kyi phreng ba mu tig dkar po dang*/

padma rā ga ltar dmar ba dang*/ mthon mthing ngam baiḍūrya ltar mthing ba dang*/ gser gyi phreng ba ltar ser ba dang*/ (455)margad kyi phreng ba ltar ljang ba lnga las rim pa bzhin/ sngags phreng ngam/ ā li kā li'i rnam par 'od zer dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ ljang khu rnams las 'od zer rim pa bzhin phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la phog /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rol pa mtha' dag rgyas par byas/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pas mchod par bsam la/ rlung ro theng gsum 'bud/ de nas rlung nang du rngub la bum pa can bzung*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi ngo bo thams cad sngags phreng dkar/ dmar/ mthing*/ ser/ ljang khu'i rnam par 'dus nas/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams kyi sgrol ma dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lnga'i thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim pas/ gti mug /'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog gi sgrib pa lnga dag /chos dbyings ye shes/ sor rtogs/ me long*/ mnyam nyid/ bya grub ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ sku lnga thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la rlung bum pa can ci nus su bzung ngo*// de bzhin du sgrol ma lnga'i thugs kha nas sngags phreng dkar dmar/ sngo ser/ ljang khu 'phros pas/ lus kyi gnas lnga gang*/ dug lnga dag /slar 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rigs drug gi sems can la phog /de dag gis gti mug /'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ phrad dog lnga dag /ye shes lnga (456)mngon du byas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rigs lnga'i sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam la rlung phyir btang ngo*// de nas de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi nus pa thams cad rang la zhugs par bsam zhing*/

khyad par du sems can thams cad la snying rje tshad med pa bskyed la/ de dag sngags phreng gi rnam par bsdus shing*/ bum pa can gyi rlung nus tshad bzung ngo*// de ni sngags phreng bum pa can la brten pa'i sbyor ba'o// de nas snod bcud rang la thim/ rang gi spyi bo'i sgrol ma mgrin pa'i sgrol ma la thim/ mgrin pa'i sgrol ma snying kha'i sgrol ma la thim/ gsang gnas kyi sgrol ma lte ba'i sgrol ma la thim/ lte ba'i sgrol ma snying kha'i sgrol ma la thim/ rang lus kyang thugs ka'i sgrol ma la thim/ thugs ka'i sgrol ma tāṃ la thim/ tāṃ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs med blo 'das kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /des ni ngag rlung dag par byed pa sngags phreng bum pa can la brten pa'i khrid de gsang dbang gi don yin/ de ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ zhi gnas/ lhag mthong*/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba ste bzhi'o// dang po la gsum/ mtshan ma la brten pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ rtog pa la sems gtad pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ rtog med du 'jog pa'i zhi gnas te gsum mo// dang po la gnyis/ phyi na sems bzung ba dang*/ nang na sems bzung ba'i/ dang po la gnyis te/ ma dag pa dang dag pa'o// dang po mdun du ka ba bum pa/ shing bu/ rde'u la sogs pa gang yang rung ba zhig la/ lus gnad lta stangs dang bcas pas ma yengs par sems bzung*/ (457)de la yengs su yang mi 'jug /rtog pa yang mi 'gyed/ gzhan yang bying rgod byung na steng 'og tu sems 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon du sems 'dzin pa yang shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ mdun du sgrol ma'i sku gzugs sam/ med na bsgom la/ de la rtog pa yang mi spro/ yengs su yang mi 'jug /de thog tu ma yengs tsam du glod nas 'jog pa ni/ dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ma dag pa dang dag pa'o// dang po ma dag pa thig le la sems bzung ba ni/

rang gi snying gar thig le dmar ser 'od 'phro ba/ sran 'bru tsam la sems bzung ste/ de la rtog pa yang mi spro/ yengs su yang mi 'jug go /gnyis pa dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems 'dzin pa ni/ rang gi snying khar pad zla'i steng du/ sgrol ma tshon gang ba 'od dang bcas pa la sems bzung*/ de la rtog pa yang mi spro/ yengs su yang mi 'jug go /byings rgod byung na sngar bzhin no// de ni mtshan ma la brten pa'i zhi gnas so// gnyis pa rtog pa la gtad nas sems bzung ba ni/ rnam rtog lhag par spros la/ dug lnga/ dug gsum/ nyon mongs pa gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i rnam rtog /dge ba bcu dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i rnam rtog la sogs/ dge mi dge'i rtog pa gang skyes pa'i ngo bo la rtog med kyis cer cer bltas na/ 'dzin med du zhi gnas/ rig pa gsal stong ngos bzung med pa/ gsal gsal 'char ba yin te/ de nyid rang rig rang ngo shes pa'i rang grol gyi ngang la ma yengs par bskyangs/ slar yang rnam rtog gang skyes pa'i ngo bo cer gyis gtad nas/ spang (458)blang med par rang ngo shes par byas la/ rnam rtog lam khyer gyi man ngag nyams su blangs bar bya'o// gsum pa zhi gnas mthar thug rtog med la sems bzung ba ni/ gnas dben par mun khang gi nang du 'bol ba'i gdan la/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ mig bar snang stong pa la had de gtad nas/ yid la 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rtog pa gsum/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa gsum la sogs pa dus gsum rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul thams cad rbad chod la btang*/ yid la ci yang mi bsam par/ sems nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar/ gsal stong 'dzin med du phyal le ba gsal le hrig ger bzhag pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i zhi gnas skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dang po rgyu'i lhag mthong*/ sems la rnam par brtag cing*/ bsgom pa ni/ 'di ltar/

bdag gi sems 'di gang nas byung zhing gang du gnas/ gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi ngo bo la brtag cing dpyad/ 'byung ba lnga rang lus la skyes sam/ gnas sam 'chi'am snyam du brtag cing dpyad par bya'o// gzhan yang sems la kha dog dkar dmar/ sngo ser ljang khra la sogs pa'i kha dog yod pa zhig gam/ med pa zhig gam snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ gzhan yang sems ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dbyibs sam/ zlum po gru bzhi zla gam nar mo 'jong mo la sogs pa'i dbyibs grub pa zhig yin nam/ dbyibs med pa zhig yin snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ sems las rnam par rtog pa gzhan zhig yin nam/ 'on te rnam par rtog pa sems yin (459)ces brtag cing dpyad/ gzhan yang phyi rol gyi snang ba sems las byung ngam 'on te snang ba las sems byung zhes brtag cing dpyad/ brtag mkhan gyi sems la yang sems kyis lta zhing dpyad/ sems 'di nyid yod pa zhig gam/ 'on te med pa zhig /gsal ba zhig gam 'on te mi gsal ba zhig /bde ba zhig gam 'on te sdug bsngal ba zhig /bdag yod pa zhig gam bdag med pa zhig /rtag pa zhig gam 'on te mi rtag pa zhig /zhi ba zhig gam ma zhi ba zhig yin snyam du brtag /snang ba zhig gam 'on te mi snang ba zhig snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ gzhan yang mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems ni ci lta bu/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems ni ci lta bu snyam du legs par rang gi sems la rang gis brtag cing dpyad/ mnyam par 'dod mkhan gyi sems kyi ngo bo la yang legs par brtag cing dpyad do// de'i tshe/ sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba/ ngo bo rang bzhin gyis stong pa nam mkha' lta bu la dbyings rang bzhin gis 'od gsal ba/ de nyid rig pa 'gag med kyi rol pa cir yang 'char zhing snang ba 'di thams cad/ skye ba med pa dang 'gag pa med pa dang*/ gnas pa med par ro mnyam/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/

rnam pa 'gag med kyi rig pa du mar 'char zhing snang ba/ dbyer med blo 'das nam mkha' lta bu la gsal rig stong gsum nam mkha' lta bur mtha' dbus med par 'dug go zhe na/ de kho na nyid do zhes/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi/ bden pa bzhi/ dga' ba bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug /sa bcu lam lnga/ thabs shes gnyis/ (460)bden pa gnyis/ skyabs 'gro/ bshags pa/ srung ba/ sems bskyed/ tshogs gnyis/ snying rje/ bskyed rim/ zhi lhag /dkon mchog gsum/ sku gsum/ ye shes lnga la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad rang ngo shes pa'i steng du ngo sprad pa la mkhas par bya'o// gnyis pa ngo bo'i lhag mthong*/ tha mal gyi shes pa so ma rang ngo sprad nas/ cig car du nyams su len pa ni/ sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi mtha' dang bral ba/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gzung 'dzin las grol zhing*/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam pa 'gag med kyi rig pa yul med du mar gsal zhing snang ba/ mthong bya mthong byed kyi 'dzin pa'i yul las 'das pa/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi dmigs pa'i yul las gol ba/ gang yang yid la mi byed pas yid byed dang bral ba/ de nyid la bzo bcos ma byas pas lhugs pa/ bya ba thams cad dang bral bas byar med/ gang shar ngos bzung dang bral bas 'dzin med/ mnyam bzhag gi shes pa la bcos slad dang bral bas had de ba/ mtshan 'dzin med pas stong sang nge ba/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas sa le ba/ rnam rtog gzung 'dzin gyis ma gos pas rjen ne ba/ rang ngo rang gis shes pas hrig ge ba/ yul yul can gyi 'dzin pa zhig pas snang sems dbyer med zang thal du phyal le ba/ rig pa ma bcos par rang lugs su 'jog pas tha mal gyi shes pa/ rnam rtog lu gu rgyud du snying 'jug pas so ma zhes bya ste/ 'di lhag mthong gi ngo bo nyams su blang bya'i dngos gzhi yin no// 'di nyid 'phags ma'i ngo bo ste/

'phags zhes pa ni ma rig gzung 'dzin (461)gyi 'khor ba las 'phags pa'o// ma zhes pa ni shes rab kyi rang rtsal gyis rang ngo shes pa'o// sgrol ces pa ni/ ma 'gag pa'i rtsal snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don 'bad med du byed pa'o// ma zhes pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyis don gnyis lhun grub ces pa'i don yin no// des na sems nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma rtogs par bya'o// zhes ngo sprad par bya'o// gsum pa mthar thug gi zhi lhag zung 'jug nyams su blangs bar bya ba ni/ sems nyid skye gnas 'jig gsum dang bral ba de nyid 'gag pa med pas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ sna tshogs du mar rig pas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ sems kyi ngo bo kha dog dbyibs su grub pa med pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid bdag med blo las 'das pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ des na rtag chad mtshan 'dzin gyis mtha' las 'das pas/ gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med pa/ zung 'jug nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs sgyu ma lta bu la sems gnas shing*/ de dag rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid du shes shing mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sems gnas pa zhi gnas yin la/ sems de'i ngo bo stong nyid blo 'das su mthong ba'i lhag mthong ngo*// bskyed rim chu zla lta bu la sems gnas pa zhi gnas/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// snang ba sems kyi rang snang chu zla lta bu la sems gnas shing*/ (462)rten 'brel skye med snang stong dbyer med du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// lam gyi mthar thug bde ba chen po la sems gnas pa zhi gnas yin la/ de nyid zhen med stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ba la sems gnas pa zhi gnas yin la/

ngo bo spros bral stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// bcos bslad dang bral ba'i rig pa so ma la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas yin la/ bdag med skye med du mthong ba lhag mthong ngo*// mdor na chu zla dang me long gi gzugs brnyan dang brag ca ltar snang ba las gzhan pa'i stong pa med/ stong pa las gzhan pa'i snang ba med/ snang stong skye med nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba lta bur rtogs nas de'i ngo bor 'jog pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug ces bya'o// de la rdzogs rim zhi lhag zung 'jug song ngo*// gsum pa 'od gsal 'dzin pa ni rang nyid sgrol mar gsal bar bskyed pa'i thugs khar/ 'khor lo ljang khu'am dkar po dngul chu'i mdog lta bu las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang*/ phyir 'phros lus kyi phyi rol thams cad nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i 'od kyis gsal gdab par byas/ de nas dpag tshad tsam 'od kyis gang bar byas/ de nas 'dzam bu gling tsam/ de nas gling bzhi/ de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od zer gyis gang bar byas/ sems can thams cad la phog pas de dag 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas/ yul yul can thams cad 'od zer gyis gang bar byas/ nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od las kyang gsal bar bsgom/ de nas sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ dmigs pa med pa'i (463)ngang nas/ rtogs med spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing 'od gsal bsgom pa'o// mtshan mo yang de lta bu'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pas/ gnyid 'od gsal du 'char bar 'gyur ro// de ni 'od gsal bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// bzhi pa 'pho ba la gnyis te/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po rang gi lus stong rang sgom pa'i snyig khar utpal rgyas pa'i steng du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ yig ljang khu zhig bsam/ rang gi spyi bor tshangs pa'i bu ga gsal haṃ re pa bsgom mo// de'i steng gi khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la/

rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ utpal rgyas pa'i steng du 'phags ma sgrol ma gsal bar bskyed pa'i zhal nas/ oṃ tā re tāṃ swā hā/ zhes gsungs pas rang gi snying kha'i tāṃ yig las thig le ljang khu zhig chad nas spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas yar thon/ spyi bo'i sgrol ma'i thugs khar reg pa re byas nas/ slar mar babs/ snying kha'i tāṃ yig la thim par bsgom slar tāṃ yig las thig le ljang khu zhig chad nas 'od dang bcas par 'phags ma'i thugs kar thim pa la dmigs pa nyi shu'am/ brgya la sogs pa bya'o// mthar thug 'jog khar spyi bor sgrol ma'i phyag g.yas na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig gis rang gi tshangs bug de bkag par bsam pa ni log non no// de ni sbyangs pa'o// gnyis pa las la sbyor ba ni/ rang la 'chi ba'i rtags (464)tshangs pa'i tshe/ zhen chags mtha' dag dang bral bar byas nas/ rang lus stong sang nge ba'i snying khar zla ba'i steng du tāṃ ljang khu 'od zer lnga 'phro bar bsam pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug rgya skar kha bye ba lta bu'i steng gi nam mkhar 'dom gang tsam gyi bar/ sgrol ma gsal bar bskyed pa'i zhal nas/ oṃ tā re tāṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags sgras bskul nas/ tāṃ yig gdan dang bcas pa nam mkhar mda' 'phang ba ltar sgrol ma'i thugs khar thim par bsam la/ rlung sems spyi bor drag tu gtad/ ngag tu hika ces brjod pas 'pho bar 'gyur ro// de ni sprul pa'i sku'i 'pho ba'o// longs sku la 'pho ba ni/ sgrol ma nam mkhar byon nas/ 'og min du rnam snang gi thugs kar thim pa'am/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams su 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim pas/ rgyal ba de dag dang dbyer med par bsam pa ni longs sku la 'pho ba'o// chos sku la 'pho ba ni/ gzugs sku de dag dmigs med du yal bar bsam la/ rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med du steng gi nam mkhar gtad pa'o// de ni chos sku la 'pho ba'o// de dag ni dngos gzhi'o// gsum pa rjes ni/

bsod nams rgya chen gyur pa 'di yis ni// 'gro ba'i don du sgrol ma mchog thob nas// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i// skye bo'i tshogs rnams sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /ces bsngo ba dang smon lam btab bo// de ni rjes so// de ltar sbyong dngos rjes gsum yongs rdzogs pa'i// (465)'phags ma sgrol ma'i khrid kyi rim pa 'di// sgrol mas mi tra dzwa ki la gnang zhing*// de yis shrī pu tra rjes su bzung*// des ni mi bskyod rdo rje rjes bzung nas// gdams ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yi// bdud rtsi bum pa gang byos tshul du ni// 'od dpag rdo rje bdag la gsungs pa rnams// brjed kyang dogs nas yi ger bkod pa'o// dge bas sems can ma lus thams cad kun// bcom ldan sgrol ma'i go 'phang mchog thob shog// /dge legs 'phel/
